fullTextEN: Hello everyone.
I am Teacher Wang.

fullTextZH: 很高兴又跟你们见面了。
fullTextEN: Very happy to meet you again.

fullTextZH: 今天王老师还要给你们讲孙悟空的故事。
fullTextEN: Today, Teacher Wang will tell you the story of Sun Wukong again.

fullTextZH: 上次的故事我们知道了，唐僧和孙悟空在去如来家的路上，遇到了一条白龙。
fullTextEN: In the last story, we learned that Tang Monk and Sun Wukong encountered a white dragon on their way to Tathagata's home.

fullTextZH: 那你们还记得孙悟空和他的师傅唐僧为什么去如来家吗？
fullTextEN: Do you still remember why Sun Wukong and his master Tang Monk went to Tathagata's home?
Correct.
They went to Tathagata's home to get books.
Tathagata's home is very, very, very far.

fullTextZH: 可是白龙吃了他们的白马。
fullTextEN: But the white dragon ate their white horse.
What happened in the end?

fullTextZH: 一个好心的神仙观音帮助了他们。
fullTextEN: A kind-hearted deity, Guanyin, helped them.

fullTextZH: 让白龙变成了一匹白马。
fullTextEN: Made the white dragon turn into a white horse.

fullTextZH: 唐僧骑着白马走得更快了。
fullTextEN: Tang Monk rode the white horse faster.
Much faster than before.
On this day,
They arrived at a place.
This place is a village.
The air is very fresh.

fullTextZH: 这个时候他们看见了一个人。
fullTextEN: At this time, they saw a person.
This person is about fourteen or fifteen years old,
is a young person.
very anxious,
walks very fast.
Sun Wukong asked him:
"May I ask what place this is?"

fullTextZH: 年轻人看见孙悟空，大声叫：“妖怪！”
fullTextEN: The young person saw Sun Wukong and shouted loudly: "Monster!"

fullTextZH: 那王老师有一个问题要问你们：
fullTextEN: Then Teacher Wang has a question to ask you:

fullTextZH: 年轻人为什么叫孙悟空妖怪呢？
fullTextEN: Why did the young person call Sun Wukong a monster?

fullTextZH: 孙悟空长得像猴子又像人，
fullTextEN: Sun Wukong looks like a monkey and also like a human,
like a human but not a human,
and can speak Chinese.
The young person is very scared,
so he called him a monster.

fullTextZH: 孙悟空告诉年轻人不要害怕，
fullTextEN: Sun Wukong told the young person not to be afraid,

fullTextZH: 自己是一个好心的猴子。
fullTextEN: that he is a kind-hearted monkey.

fullTextZH: 他问年轻人：“你为什么走这么快，
fullTextEN: He asked the young person: "Why are you walking so fast,
so anxious?"

fullTextZH: 年轻人说：“我家有一个很坏的妖怪。
fullTextEN: The young person said: "There is a very bad monster at my home.

fullTextZH: 我的爷爷让我去找一个厉害的人打妖怪。”
fullTextEN: My grandpa asked me to find a powerful person to fight the monster."

fullTextZH: 孙悟空最喜欢打妖怪了。
fullTextEN: Sun Wukong loves fighting monsters the most.
He told Tang Seng:

fullTextZH: “我们去他们家帮助他打妖怪吧。”
fullTextEN: "Let's go to their house to help him fight monsters."
Although Tang Seng is very afraid of monsters,
he really likes helping people.

fullTextZH: 他们就去了年轻人的家。
fullTextEN: So they went to the young man's house.
The young man's house is very big,
with two floors.

fullTextZH: 在那个时候，只有有钱人才有这么大这么高的房子。
fullTextEN: At that time, only rich people had such big and tall houses.
They entered the door,
and saw an old man.
This old man was sixty or seventy years old.

fullTextZH: 老人看见孙悟空，又害怕又生气。
fullTextEN: The old man saw Sun Wukong and was both scared and angry.

fullTextZH: 他对年轻人说：“我让你出来找一个厉害的人打妖怪，
fullTextEN: He said to the young man: "I asked you to find a strong person to fight monsters,

fullTextZH: 你怎么带回来一个妖怪？”
fullTextEN: how did you bring back a monster?"
Sun Wukong said: "Old man,
I am not a monster,
I am a kind-hearted monkey."

fullTextZH: 唐僧告诉孙悟空不能没有礼貌，
fullTextEN: Tang Seng told Sun Wukong not to be rude,
and to call the old man 'grandpa' when meeting him.
You can't call him an old man.

fullTextZH: 孙悟空觉得：“我已经500多岁了，
fullTextEN: Sun Wukong thought: "I am already over 500 years old,
much older than him."

fullTextZH: 可是孙悟空很听师傅的话。
fullTextEN: But Sun Wukong listened to his master.

fullTextZH: 他对老爷爷说：“老爷爷，不要害怕，
fullTextEN: He said to the old man: "Old man, don't be afraid,
I am a kind-hearted monkey,
I will help you fight the monster."

fullTextZH: 可是老人看见孙悟空又瘦又小，
fullTextEN: But the old man saw Sun Wukong was thin and small,
and not tall,
still just a monkey,
unable to fight monsters.
Tang Monk told the old man: "Old man,
let me introduce him,
his name is Sun Wukong,

fullTextZH: 500年以前跟天上的神仙打过架，
fullTextEN: 500 years ago, he fought with the celestial beings,

fullTextZH: 天上的神仙都打不过他。
fullTextEN: the celestial beings couldn't defeat him.
He is very powerful,
and also very capable,
he can help you."
The old man was very happy to hear this,

fullTextZH: 邀请唐僧和孙悟空吃饭。
fullTextEN: Invite Tang Seng and Sun Wukong to dinner.
During the meal,

fullTextZH: 老人告诉了孙悟空这个妖怪的故事。
fullTextEN: The old man told Sun Wukong the story of this monster.

fullTextZH: 这是一只什么样的妖怪呢？
fullTextEN: What kind of monster is this?
Why does the old man want to fight the monster?
I will tell you next time.
Goodbye!
